title: .respawnpack/runtime/rollover/<host>-<conversationId>/<handoffId>.verified.json — the handoff read-back receipt
description: Written by core/state/handoff.js's writeVerified() AFTER it wrote the handoff document, read the bytes back, and compared two digests. No receipt for a handoffId means that handoff was never read back and MAY NOT be injected — core/lifecycle/consumable.js's consume() refuses (HANDOFF_UNVERIFIED) rather than trusting a write it cannot prove. `equal` is always true when this file exists at all: a failed comparison (writeVerified returning ok:false) leaves NO receipt on disk, so the receipt's mere existence already answers the question its own `equal` field restates. GITIGNORED, machine-local. No schemaVersion: this is a receipt with a single-purpose lifetime bound to one handoffId, not a document meant to outlive a format change.

equal.description: Always true when this receipt exists — see the family description. Declared as a real boolean field anyway rather than a bare presence flag, because a comparison result silently assumed is exactly what the digests beside it exist to make checkable.
